Noah Kim: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem 1: recurring pattern summary: (1) upstream auth-edge rate-limiting produces token refresh storms, (2) registry leader write stalls under retry pressure. We need a compact owner + timeline table and explicit runbook changes.
Maya Patel: Thanks Noah. I want concrete owners for short vs mid vs long term. Short: protective knobs and runbook. Mid: telemetry + synthetic. Long: infra (regional replicas / active-passive).
Aisha Rahman: I'll own short-term protections. Plan: local token grace (+30s), per-client refresh semaphore (max 4 concurrent), and a light circuit-breaker on registry writes that returns 429 with Retry-After. ETA: 48h.
Diego Morales: I'll take telemetry + synthetic. Tasks: add auth.refresh.success_rate by region, registry.write.p95/p99, and a 15m synthetic that posts a tiny model-tag and validates token exchange. Alert if synthetic fails twice in 30m. ETA: 72h.
Noah Kim: I'll handle vendor engagement: open formal RCA request, ask for per-customer vs per-IP limit detail, and request temporary edge smoothing (spread refreshes by up to 2s). ETA: vendor outreach by Thu.
Maya Patel: Runbook draft (short):
```
- If auth.refresh.success_rate < 97% for 10m -> page infra oncall
- Infra oncall: enable local token-grace (+30s) and enable client refresh semaphore
- If registry.write.p95 > 1s for 5m -> enable circuit-breaker and reject heavy batches to degraded path
- Escalate to vendor owner (Noah) with evidence bundle if vendor indicators present
```
Aisha Rahman: I'll post PRs for token-grace + semaphore. Metrics added: auth.refresh.blocked_count and registry.write.circuit_open_count. PR WIP and link will go here.
Diego Morales: Synthetic will be added to smoke-harness and instrumented. Creating INC-4999 to track synthetic + alerts. ops-bot: please create ticket.
ops-bot: Created ticket INC-4999: "registry-synthetic-and-short-term-protections". Link: https://issues.redwood/INC-4999
Noah Kim: Vendor ticket VND-9001 opened and assigned to vendor SRE lead. Asked for log slices for the three incident windows and requested edge smoothing config change. Scheduled vendor sync Fri 09:30 PT.
Maya Patel: Ownership summary for visibility: short-term protections: Aisha, telemetry + synthetic: Diego, vendor engagement: Noah, incident tracking: Ops (ops-bot).
Aisha Rahman: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/registry/pull/1555 (token-grace + refresh semaphore) 1 WIP tests failing on a flaky env, will iterate.
Diego Morales: Dashboard + alerts created, synthetic deployed to smoke harness. Will post INC-4999 subtasks once triaged.
Noah Kim: Vendor acknowledged ticket and requested our retry traces. Shared logs in VND-9001.
Maya Patel: Timeline recap: short protections 48h, telemetry + synthetic 72h, vendor outreach Thu, vendor sync Fri 09:30 PT. We will run the synthetic for 7 days and reconvene to decide long-term architecture (regional passive replicas, token mirror). If anyone hits a blocker, ping here and update the ticket. :eyes:
